rows.jyutping: tung4 jan4 daa2 sing4 jat1 pin3
rows.note: Use this when mingling socially and becoming friendly with different people at an event.

example.english: At the company anniversary dinner, I quickly got to mingle with everyone.
example.traditional: 公司周年晚宴嗰晚，我好快就同人打成一片。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3 go2 maan5 ngo5 hou2 faai3 zau6 tung4 jan4 daa2 sing4 jat1 pin3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for mixing or combining separate things or parts.

example.english: When making soup, I like to mingle the carrots and potatoes together.
example.traditional: 煲湯嗰陣，我鍾意將紅蘿蔔同薯仔撈埋一齊。
example.jyutping: bou1 tong1 go2 zan6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoeng1 hung4 lo4 baak6 tung4 syu4 zai2 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this when separate things or substances end up mixed or blended together.

example.english: Before the oil paint dries, the colours can mingle together if you are not careful.
example.traditional: 油彩未乾之前，啲顏色一唔小心就會混埋一齊。
example.jyutping: jau4 coi2 mei6 gon1 zi1 cin4 di1 ngaan4 sik1 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 zau6 wui5 wan6 maai4 jat1 cai4
